items.title: ICYMI: Confirm Todd Blanche as Attorney General
items.summary: President Donald J. Trump’s nominee for Attorney General, Todd Blanche, should be confirmed by the U.S. Senate without delay. As President Trump has stated, “Todd Blanche is a STAR, and everyone knows it!” A broad coalition of law enforcement organizations, state attorneys general, former Justice Department officials, editorial boards, legal experts, advocacy groups, and Members […] The post ICYMI: Confirm Todd Blanche as Attorney General appeared first on The White House.

items.titleZh: 不容错过：确认托德·布兰奇为司法部长
items.summaryZh: 白宫呼吁参议院尽快确认托德·布兰奇为司法部长。特朗普总统称其为“明星”，并获得了执法组织及法律专家的广泛支持。
items.whyImportant: 司法部长职位的任命对美国政府的法律执行和政策实施至关重要。

items.title: ‘Strategic partner’: Peru’s Fujimori plans to intensify ties with the US
items.summary: Peru's newly inaugurated president indicates her government will join Trump's Shield of the Americas coalition.
tags: 专题·美国政策与全球影响
items.titleZh: “战略伙伴”：秘鲁藤森计划加强与美国的联系
items.summaryZh: 秘鲁新任总统表示，其政府将加入特朗普的“美洲盾”联盟，旨在深化与美国的战略合作关系。
items.whyImportant: 秘鲁外交政策的转向反映了拉美国家在当前地缘政治环境下寻求与美国更紧密结盟的趋势。

items.title: Massive Attack barred from Singapore for unfurling Palestinian flag on stage
items.summary: British trip-hop band Massive Attack has been barred from performing in Singapore after an investigation found two members unfurled a Palestinian flag during a concert, police said. Two band members who held the flag on stage during a concert on Wednesday were also banned from re-entering Singapore and issued with warnings, police said in a statement late on Friday, without naming the pair. Singapore, known for its tough laws on public speech and assembly, bans the open display of all foreign...
items.titleZh: Massive Attack乐队因在舞台上展示巴勒斯坦国旗被新加坡禁止入境
items.summaryZh: 英国Trip-hop乐队Massive Attack的两名成员因在演唱会上展示巴勒斯坦国旗，被新加坡警方禁止再次入境并受到警告。新加坡法律严禁在公共场合展示外国旗帜或进行未经许可的政治抗议。
items.whyImportant: 此举凸显了新加坡对公共秩序和政治表达的严格管控，以及对外国艺人参与当地政治活动的零容忍态度。

items.title: 4 killed in Russian strikes on Ukraine as Zelensky pushes Trump for Patriot missiles
items.summary: Russian strikes on Ukraine’s capital killed at least four people and wounded more than a dozen others, local officials said on Saturday, after Kyiv’s mayor warned of a ballistic missile attack. It comes after the United Nations found June was the deadliest month for civilians in Ukraine since April 2022. Russia has stepped up long-range strikes ⁠on ⁠the capital in recent months, while Ukraine ‌is chronically short of air defences capable of ‌downing ballistic ‌missiles, which travel at ‌several...
items.titleZh: 俄罗斯袭击乌克兰致4人死亡，泽连斯基敦促特朗普提供爱国者导弹
items.summaryZh: 俄罗斯对乌克兰首都基辅发动导弹袭击，造成至少4人死亡及多人受伤。在乌克兰防空系统严重短缺的情况下，泽连斯基正寻求美国提供更多爱国者导弹以应对日益频繁的远程打击。
items.whyImportant: 乌克兰防空能力的不足正导致平民伤亡增加，进一步加剧了该国在战争中的脆弱性。

items.title: Russian missile attack kills three in Ukraine’s Kyiv
items.summary: Residents trapped as partially collapsed building catches fire after deadly strike on Ukrainian capital.
items.titleZh: 俄罗斯导弹袭击乌克兰基辅，造成三人死亡
items.summaryZh: 乌克兰首都基辅遭到致命导弹袭击，导致建筑物部分坍塌并引发火灾，有居民被困。救援行动正在进行中。
items.whyImportant: 针对城市基础设施的持续袭击加剧了乌克兰的人道主义危机。

items.title: 【地震情報】北海道 青森 岩手で震度4(11:48)
items.summary: 1日午前11時48分ごろ北海道と青森県、岩手県で震度4の揺れを観測する地震がありました。この地震による津波の心配はありません。
items.titleZh: 【地震情报】北海道、青森、岩手观测到震度4级地震（11:48）
items.summaryZh: 8月1日上午11时48分左右，日本北海道、青森县和岩手县发生震度4级的地震。目前没有引发海啸的风险。
items.whyImportant: 此次地震提醒当地居民保持警惕，尽管未造成海啸威胁，但仍需防范余震。

items.title: きょうも危険な暑さに 地震被災地も猛暑予想 熱中症対策を
items.summary: 1日も西日本と東日本を中心に気温が上がり、午前中から猛烈な暑さとなっています。熊本県の地震の被災地では連日、猛暑となっていて、引き続き熱中症への対策を徹底してください。一方、前線の影響で東北では雨が強まって「レベル4土砂災害危険警報」が発表されている地域があり、土砂災害に厳重な警戒が必要です。
items.titleZh: 今日仍有危险高温，地震灾区预计酷暑，请注意防暑降温
items.summaryZh: 日本西日本和东日本地区气温持续升高，熊本县地震灾区面临连日酷暑，需严防中暑。同时，东北地区受锋面影响降雨增强，部分地区发布了泥石流灾害预警。
items.whyImportant: 极端天气与地震灾害叠加，增加了灾区救援和民众生活的难度。

items.title: 熊本地震 関連調査中含め36人死亡 9200人余りが避難 県発表
items.summary: 熊本県は今回の地震で県内では災害との関連を調査している2人を含めて36人が死亡し、9200人余りが避難していると発表しました。県内では猛烈な暑さが続くと予想され、県は飲料水の確保や避難所での暑さ対策を進めています。
items.titleZh: 熊本县政府宣布：地震已致36人死亡，9200余人避难
items.summaryZh: 熊本县政府确认地震已造成36人死亡（含2名关联死亡者），超过9200人处于避难状态。政府正全力保障避难所的饮用水供应及防暑措施。
items.whyImportant: 灾后伤亡人数的确认和避难安置是当前救灾工作的核心任务。

items.title: Petrol prices on track to top $2 a litre as Bowen sounds death knell for fuel excise relief
items.summary: Petrol now costs more than $1.90 a litre in every capital city, with diesel expected to exceed $2.40 a litre Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Petrol prices could surpass $2 a litre and diesel $2.40 in coming days, after the government’s 16-cent discount ends on Sunday. The 32-cent per litre reduction in fuel excise, introduced in March at the peak of the fuel price spike, was halved to 16 cents in July. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 随着燃油税减免政策结束，汽油价格有望突破每升2澳元
items.summaryZh: 由于政府的燃油税减免政策即将到期，澳大利亚各首府城市的汽油价格预计将上涨。汽油价格可能超过每升2澳元，柴油价格则可能超过2.40澳元。
items.whyImportant: 燃油价格上涨将直接增加民众的生活成本，并可能加剧通胀压力。

items.title: Trump says ‘complete disarmament’ of Hamas agreed in Gaza but Israel yet to accept
items.summary: US president hails breakthrough but Israeli far-right minister says ‘only solution’ is ‘encouraging emigration and destroying Hamas’ Middle East crisis – live updates What is Trump’s Board of Peace and who is involved? Donald Trump has declared a breakthrough in negotiations over the disarmament of Hamas in Gaza and the withdrawal of Israeli forces, issues that have so far stalled the implementation of last October’s ceasefire, but Israel has yet to respond officially to the plan and government officials have voiced scepticism over the deal. Announcing the agreement in a social media post on Thursday night, Trump said it involved the “complete disarmament” of Hamas and other armed groups in Gaza and was “a monumental step toward ending the fighting”. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 特朗普称加沙哈马斯已同意“彻底解除武装”，但以色列尚未接受
items.summaryZh: 美国总统特朗普宣布在加沙停火谈判中取得突破，称哈马斯同意解除武装，但以色列政府对此表示怀疑且尚未正式回应。该协议旨在结束加沙的战斗。
items.whyImportant: 若该协议无法获得以色列的认可，加沙地区的冲突恐将持续，和平进程面临重大不确定性。

items.title: Israel launches attacks across Gaza one day after Hamas agrees to disarm
items.summary: Israeli attacks across Gaza have killed at least two Palestinians, hours after Hamas agreed to a draft peace deal.
items.titleZh: 哈马斯同意解除武装后，以色列对加沙发动袭击
items.summaryZh: 在哈马斯同意一项停火协议草案数小时后，以色列在加沙各地发动袭击，造成至少两名巴勒斯坦人死亡。局势依然紧张。
items.whyImportant: 停火协议与军事行动并存，显示出冲突双方在达成持久和平方面仍存在巨大鸿沟。

items.title: Adani to pay no company tax despite $1bn revenue from Queensland coalmine
items.summary: Indian conglomerate offsets earnings from Carmichael mine to report $340.6m loss, after promising billions in taxes and royalties Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Indian conglomerate Adani will pay no company tax despite generating almost $1bn in revenue from coal mining in Queensland over the past year. Financial accounts show the Carmichael thermal coal operations used large costs – including production and related party logistics expenses – to offset its $963.5m revenue in the 12 months to 31 March. This resulted in a recorded $340.6m loss for the year, erasing its tax bill. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 阿达尼集团尽管从昆士兰煤矿获得10亿澳元收入，却无需缴纳公司税
items.summaryZh: 印度企业集团阿达尼通过将生产和物流成本抵消收入，使其卡迈克尔煤矿项目在财报中显示亏损，从而免缴公司税。此前该公司曾承诺缴纳数十亿税款和特许权使用费。
items.whyImportant: 跨国企业利用财务手段避税引发了公众对资源开发收益分配公平性的质疑。

items.summary: Chinese tech investors are hearing warning bells after volatility in US tech stocks forced a fast-rising Wall Street hedge fund to clear its stock portfolio at a steep discount within a few days. “Don’t use leverage! Don’t use leverage! Don’t use leverage!” Shanghai-based public-markets analyst Harry Shen repeated to the South China Morning Post in an interview on Friday. Another warning came from Shanghai-based mainland Chinese stock market veteran Michael Zhang: “Don’t trade with borrowed...
items.titleZh: 美国AI对冲基金抛售潮对中国投资者敲响警钟
items.summaryZh: 美国科技股波动导致一家知名对冲基金被迫低价清仓，引发中国科技投资者的警惕。分析人士警告称，应避免过度使用杠杆和借贷交易。
items.whyImportant: 全球金融市场的联动效应提醒中国投资者在动荡的市场环境中需更加审慎。

items.title: Ready player 3: India offers Asean a US-China alternative
items.summary: At a food fair in New Delhi, a vegetable exporter from the Philippines set out its wares: bags of dried moringa and lemongrass, bundles of taro leaves and a bowl of laing, the creamy coconut-milk stew made from them. The question Dry Tech Manufacturing wanted to answer was simple: could the simple Filipino food it sells under its Sheentaro brand tantalise the taste buds of the world’s most populous country? India has hundreds of millions of vegetarians, more than any other country on Earth,...
items.titleZh: 准备好第三位玩家：印度为东盟提供美中之外的替代选择
items.summaryZh: 印度正通过加强与东盟的贸易联系，试图在美中竞争的格局中提供新的经济选择。菲律宾等国企业正积极探索进入印度庞大的消费市场。
items.whyImportant: 印度在区域贸易中的角色日益凸显，可能改变亚洲的经济地缘格局。

items.title: Going Dutch: why taste of Hong Kong-style milk tea is Black and White
items.summary: A single canned ingredient imported from the Netherlands has quietly fuelled Hong Kong’s daily hustle for the past 85 years, evolving from a simple dairy product into the soul of local diner culture. For decades, the Black and White brand of full-cream evaporated milk has been a crucial element in Hong Kong-style milk tea culture and craftsmanship, giving this popular drink in the city’s cha chaan teng – local cafes – its signature fragrance, thickness and smoothness. “Everything starts from a...
items.titleZh: 荷兰制造：为何港式奶茶的灵魂是“黑白”淡奶
items.summaryZh: 源自荷兰的“黑白”牌全脂淡奶已成为港式奶茶文化中不可或缺的元素。85年来，这种进口原料赋予了港式奶茶独特的香气、厚度和顺滑口感。
items.whyImportant: 这一现象展示了全球化贸易如何深度融入并塑造了香港独特的饮食文化。

items.title: Should Hong Kong regulate loot boxes as addiction issues arise in mobile gaming?
items.summary: Playing strategic and role-playing mobile games has been a major leisure activity for Peter Lee* since he graduated in 2020, when social distancing measures during the Covid-19 pandemic left him with little to do outside working hours. Unlike console games, Lee gained a sense of belonging in the mobile gaming world, as he could interact and cooperate with players from different countries whenever and wherever he wanted. To enhance his team’s performance in battles, the 28-year-old bought loot...
items.titleZh: 随着移动游戏成瘾问题浮现，香港是否应监管“战利品箱”？
items.summaryZh: 香港移动游戏玩家通过购买“战利品箱”以提升游戏表现，引发了对游戏成瘾及消费行为的担忧。社会各界正讨论是否需要引入监管措施。
items.whyImportant: 数字娱乐产业的快速发展带来了新的社会问题，监管政策的滞后性成为讨论焦点。

items.title: China is making a great leap forward in food production – this time for real
items.summary: In June 1958, as China’s Great Leap Forward campaign gained traction, state media began reporting astronomical agricultural yields, including claims from central Henan province of over 3,000 jin per mu – more than 22 tonnes per hectare. That month, scientist Qian Xuesen, father of China’s rocket programme, published theoretical calculations on maximum solar energy conversion during crop photosynthesis, which political cadres cited to validate the claims. In the following months, reported yield...
items.titleZh: 中国在粮食生产上实现大跃进——这一次是真实的
items.summaryZh: 与过去虚报产量的历史不同，中国当前的粮食生产在科技进步的推动下取得了实质性增长。现代农业技术正在显著提升单位面积产量。
items.whyImportant: 粮食生产的稳步增长对保障中国国家安全和应对全球粮食挑战具有重要意义。

items.title: HIV prevention drug could reduce cases globally but USAID cuts prevent access, say experts
items.summary: Injectable PrEP drug holds promise but investment in HIV prevention has declined dramatically worldwide Sign up for the Breaking News US newsletter email New innovations in HIV prevention could dramatically reduce the number of new HIV cases around the globe, but US foreign aid cuts will mean that those that most need the new medication will be unable to access it, according to experts at the Aids 2026 Conference in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. One year ago, the World Health Organization recommended that governments around the world prioritize expanded access to lenacapavir, an injectable version of the HIV prevention medication PrEP that requires only two injections annually. PrEP, which also comes in the form of daily oral medications and bimonthly injections, is 99% effective in preventing sexually transmitted HIV for people who take it consistently. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 专家称HIV预防药物可减少全球病例，但美国援助削减阻碍了获取
items.summaryZh: 尽管长效注射型PrEP药物在预防HIV方面表现出极高有效性，但美国对外援助的削减导致贫困地区民众难以获得该药物。专家呼吁全球优先扩大药物获取渠道。
items.whyImportant: 公共卫生资金的削减可能抵消医疗技术进步带来的抗疫成果，加剧全球健康不平等。

items.title: NSW should compensate elderly woman whose public housing was inundated with sewage, ombudsman finds
items.summary: Ombudsman finds Homes NSW acted unreasonably and recommended additional payment for distress and suffering Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast An elderly public housing tenant whose home was damaged by sewage overflows will be fully compensated by the New South Wales government after it disposed of her personal belongings without her consent and failed to properly support her insurance claim. The NSW Ombudsman on Friday published its report after an investigation in which it found Homes NSW acted unreasonably in how it handled the tenant’s contaminated belongings and “failed to provide full and accurate information to the insurer”. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 监察员裁定：新南威尔士州应赔偿公共住房被污水淹没的老年租户
items.summaryZh: 新南威尔士州监察员发现，政府住房部门在处理一名老年租户的受损财物时行为不当，且未向保险公司提供准确信息。政府被建议对该租户进行全额赔偿。
items.whyImportant: 此裁定强调了政府机构在公共服务中应承担的责任，并保护了弱势群体的合法权益。

items.title: Sudan civil war: When drones strike the classroom
items.summary: Children in Sudan's besieged city of el-Obeid are afraid to go to school as drone attacks hit civilian infrastructure. Aid groups warn of a worsening humanitarian crisis.
items.titleZh: 苏丹内战：当无人机袭击教室
items.summaryZh: 苏丹城市埃尔奥贝德的无人机袭击频繁击中民用基础设施，导致儿童不敢上学。援助组织警告称，当地的人道主义危机正在持续恶化。
items.whyImportant: 针对学校等民用目标的袭击严重侵犯了人权，并使苏丹的未来一代面临生存威胁。

items.title: Japan’s ruling party MPs form group to protect US$2.1 billion trading card market
items.summary: Lawmakers from Japan’s ruling Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) have launched a group aimed at promoting the rapidly growing trading card industry, seeing its potential as a globally competitive content sector. The group, consisting of some 20 lawmakers, is seeking to improve the trading card environment by setting up rules to address issues such as counterfeit cards and bulk purchases for resale. It is also keen to enhance market transparency to support the industry’s overseas expansion. The...
items.titleZh: 日本执政党议员成立小组，旨在保护价值21亿美元的集换式卡牌市场
items.summaryZh: 日本自民党议员成立了一个跨党派小组，旨在规范集换式卡牌行业，打击假冒产品和恶意囤货行为。该小组希望通过提高市场透明度，支持该产业的全球化扩张。
items.whyImportant: 随着集换式卡牌市场规模的扩大，政府介入监管有助于维护市场秩序并促进文化产业出口。
